_comment: veld_wrapd config for the custody box. Production fails closed unless its ranged P2TR wallet, exact C1 operational manifest, and separately pinned compiled Veld consensus custody identity agree.
_public_capacity_policy_ack: C1 production policy is loaded only from the one owner-signed JSON artifact below. The allocator and witness expose and compare its exact byte SHA-256.
_allocation_store_initialization: For the audited first-start ceremony only: verify the exact descriptor/Core next index and backups, set true, start once (it creates/fsyncs the empty journal then intentionally exits), immediately set false, and restart. Never leave true or use it to replace a missing/rolled-back journal.
_allocation_witness_policy: This is a dedicated SSH key/forced command, never the mint-signer reservation key. An address is not returned until the independent witness durably registers its exact index, script, recipient and amount and C1E1 reaches canonical depth.
_allocation_policy: C1: ML-DSA-65 principal, current-only 24-bit/600-second beacon work, 5/epoch and 200/day, 5,000,000-sat principal/destination ceilings, 10,000-sat minimum, public indices 1000-10999, seven-day unfunded expiry without index reuse, 100,000 rows/64 MiB with 10% lifecycle reserve, C5 freshness phases, authoritative candidate-height launch/liveness gate, and mandatory independent witness/WORM parity.
